The problem

Too many possibilities.
Too little time to weigh them.

Fleet profitability starts with which contracts to take and how to fill the gaps between them. A strong rate can hide an empty return trip. A promising backhaul can put tomorrow’s commitment at risk.

Planners weigh these decisions while handling calls, delays, cancellations, and breakdowns. There are more combinations than a team can compare by hand—and every disruption changes the tradeoffs.

Our approach

Optimize the whole plan.
Then put it into motion.

Mathematical optimization weighs revenue, costs, forecasts, and driver constraints together. AI agents carry the plan through the operation and adapt as the day changes.
Inside our operation

Four agents.
One operation.

01 Sourcing

Finds backhauls and complementary freight around customer commitments and each truck’s next move.

02 Planning

Compares load assignments, routes, and positioning across revenue, costs, available hours, and driver schedules.

03 Dispatch

Coordinates trucks and drivers, preparing new assignments when availability or plans change.

04 Communications

Keeps drivers, brokers, and customers connected through calls, messages, and trip updates.
